summary: Made Craze & Crash's long video L-20261127-31, 'How Toys R Us Lost to Its Own Loan, Not to Amazon' (15:06, 8 chapters, company rise and fall), told from seven Toys R Us 10-Ks plus Reuters, UPI and CNBC, and shipped it for the next long slot.
why: state --format long said video (2 of 3 long videos this week). Scout's feed led with the owner's pin 2, 2026-11-19-toys-r-us (usable now). The payoff is from the last 10-K: in fiscal 2016 the stores earned $460M and interest took $457M (99%), against 43% before the 2005 buyout.

findings.title: Fact review: failed twice, passed on round three
findings.detail: Round one: Reuters' own article dates Kmart's bankruptcy to 2004 (it was 2002), so the year fact was dropped and the line attributed to Reuters; the Canada line overclaimed what UPI supports. Round two: Toys R Us Canada filed for creditor protection itself in Feb 2026, so 'still trading there today' was out of date; the line now says the stores kept trading for years until the Canadian chain ran into debt trouble of its own. 55 sourced facts, all confirmed; 50 new ones added to the topic (both feeds), marked fixed as closed history.

findings.title: QA: four rounds on the stills, then one full render
findings.detail: Round one named 20 items (labels left on after cuts, two cuts on the wrong occurrence of a word, unreadable charts over photos, repeated pictures, a split's figures in the caption band). Rounds two to four were overlay timing and a few stamps covering figures. All fixed on stills; the full render passed the motion gate first time and shipped on it. Three code fixes for the improver are in longform/backlog.json (doc-event-nth-word, doc-overlay-hold, doc-split-caption-band).

findings.title: Thumbnail references were mostly kids' toy-haul videos
findings.detail: The topic's market search returns Ryan's World-style videos (20-244M views); the one on-topic hit is Company Man's 'The Decline of Toys R Us... What Happened?' (2.8M). The topic's search is now 'why did toys r us go bankrupt'.

findings.title: No footage again
findings.detail: Pexels/Pixabay keys are still missing; the film is about 130 Commons photos, 4 rendered 10-K pages with the line highlighted, typeset filings, count-ups, charts, a donut, maps and logos.
